findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/artifact-release.ts:181 and packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:241 make artifact-release idempotency stop before durable commit: if DONE appends .lattice/artifact-releases.jsonl then commitArtifactReleaseLedgerIfNeeded fails or the process dies before the git commit, a retry sees status=already_recorded and returns at line 241 without staging/committing the dirty ledger. That violates the artifact provenance durability/idempotency boundary and can leave DONE reporting an already-recorded release with no committed provenance row. Severity high.

packages/main/src/core/artifact-release.ts:181 and packages/main/src/handlers/done-effects.ts:241 make artifact-release idempotency stop before durable commit: if DONE appends .lattice/artifact-releases.jsonl but commitArtifactReleaseLedgerIfNeeded fails or the process dies before the git commit, a retry reads the dirty ledger as already_recorded and returns without staging/committing it. This can leave DONE reporting an already-recorded artifact release with no committed provenance row.
